name: submit_avatar_video
description:
Submit a final AI-avatar video generation batch and create video assets in the current project library. This tool does not create an avatar identity, choose a voice, place clips on the timeline, or export. Load the digital-human Skill first. Call only when the user's current intent has a ready avatar and all required speech, script, aspect-ratio, resolution, and consent constraints resolved. Use the opaque defaultVoiceRef returned by manage_avatar catalog/list/get after the user accepts an official avatar's built-in voice, or automatically for a saved custom avatar unless the user explicitly asks to change voices. Otherwise use an opaque voiceRef returned by action=voices after the user chooses another voice, or one project audio asset. ChatCut resolves the generation provider and engine; never request or expose them. For project audio, pass the original asset to this tool exactly once. Do not inspect its file extension or container, transcode it, split it with Bash or media tools, import replacement parts, or call this tool once per part. ChatCut automatically prepares over-limit audio and submits all ordered parts as one generation batch. If progress narration is useful, say only that ChatCut is splitting the long audio while preserving its complete content and order. Do not add implementation details about where or how the work runs. Pass speech as a JSON object, never as a quoted or JSON-stringified value. For example: {"type":"audio-asset","assetId":"..."} or {"type":"voice","voiceRef":"...","text":"..."}. After all slots are resolved, this tool obtains a live credit estimate and shows it in the final generation confirmation card before submitting. Never calculate or quote a hardcoded avatar-video price. The result contains batch, task, segment, and generation job IDs. Generation continues in the background and completed videos appear in the project library. End the turn immediately after submission. Never call track_progress, manage_avatar action=get-batch, or add a Bash sleep in the same turn. In a later user turn, use track_progress only when the user asks for status or resumes a follow-up step that needs the completed asset. Do not quote non-terminal numeric progress to the user because it represents coarse internal stages, not a completion estimate. Use manage_avatar action=get-batch for ordered segment and attempt state.

ChatCut Desktop override: after a successful submission, call track_progress with target="generation", action="wait", and every returned job ID unless the user explicitly asked only to queue the work. Desktop waits reactively until completion, failure, or user interruption; never use Bash sleep or busy-polling.

If confirmation times out or is cancelled before the user answers, ask the user to retry.

aspectRatio.description: Output aspect ratio. Explicit user choice wins; otherwise omit it so ChatCut preserves the selected avatar's original ratio.

identityId.description: Ready ChatCut avatar identity id returned by manage_avatar or attached from the Digital Humans library. Official identities are directly usable and do not need to be imported first.

identityRevisionId.description: Specific ready revision id. Omit to use the identity's active revision.

motionPrompt.description: Optional performance direction, only when live capabilities support it.

removeBackground.description: Transparent-background preference. Omit by default. Set true only when the user explicitly requests transparency or background removal; set false when they explicitly want the original background.

segments.description: Optional explicit ordered text segments. Omit for automatic segmentation. Not valid for audio-asset speech.

speech.description: Speech source object. Pass an object such as {"type":"audio-asset","assetId":"..."} or {"type":"voice","voiceRef":"...","text":"..."}; never JSON.stringify it.

assetId.description: The original ChatCut audio asset id. Submit it once without inspecting its container, transcoding it, splitting it, importing derived parts, or making separate generation calls; ChatCut automatically prepares over-limit audio and submits the ordered parts as one batch.

voiceRef.description: Opaque ChatCut voice reference returned by manage_avatar as defaultVoiceRef, or by action=voices after the user chooses another voice.
